heldButUnwritten.reason: the platform holds a value for this blank and this build does not write it: the platform holds this case number as matter.case_number and the write is refused rather than unavailable -- the value itself is not repeated into this record. the platform's shared field semantics protect every blank whose printed line names a magistrate: PROTECT_RULES matches /magistrate/ under the "court" category, so "Metropolitan/Magistrate/Municipal Court case number(s)" and "[ ] Magistrate Court in ____ (location)" refuse every write whatever fact is offered. That rule is shared by the whole corpus and re-labelling the blank until it stops matching it would be wording a refusal to beat a regex, so the line is left to the participant and the ground is stated. Reported in build-findings.json.
